title: Recapture of Unissued Fee-Free Card Kits on Early Termination — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
**Clause.** When an early termination fee is figured for a Paystride Payroll Card Program, an amount is added for kits supplied without kit fee that are still unissued: the lesser of the program's unissued kits held and the kits supplied without fee, these being the kits on all of the program's kit orders less the kits charged on its kit fees, priced at the kit fee of the package held. For a program that launched fewer than 12 whole months before today the whole of that amount is added, for one that launched at least 12 but fewer than 24 whole months before today 0.5 of it, and for an older program, or one with no launch date, nothing.

Whole months are the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the launch date's.

### Share of the amount added

| Whole months since launch | Share added |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | the whole amount |
| at least 12, fewer than 24 | one half (0.5) |
| 24 or more, or no launch date | nothing |

### Worked figure (hypothetical, Select package, kit fee 2.50)

1. Kits on all kit orders: 250. Kits charged on kit fees: 120. Kits supplied without fee: 130.
2. Unissued kits held: 85. The lesser of 85 and 130 is 85.
3. Priced at 2.50: 212.50.
4. Launched 15 whole months ago: half is added, 106.25. Launched 8 whole months ago: 212.50 is added. Launched 30 whole months ago: nothing.
